SELECT r.id AS id, r.batch_id AS batch_id, r.ingestion_batch_id AS ingestion_batch_id, r.source_row_id AS source_row_id, to_char(r.canonical_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS canonical_date, to_char(r.transaction_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS transaction_date, to_char(r.posting_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS posting_date, r.canonical_date_basis AS canonical_date_basis, r.reference AS reference, r.source_transaction_id AS source_transaction_id, r.description AS description, r.account_code AS account_code, r.monetary_basis AS monetary_basis, r.debit::text AS debit, r.credit::text AS credit, r.source_amount::text AS source_amount, r.entry_side AS entry_side, r.derived_ledger_net::text AS derived_ledger_net, r.balance::text AS balance, r.currency AS currency, r.currency_basis AS currency_basis, r.ingestion_status AS ingestion_status FROM public.financial_records r
WHERE r.batch_id = ANY($1::uuid[]) AND r.ingestion_status IN ('VALID', 'WARNING') AND r.currency = $2 ORDER BY r.canonical_date DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT $3::integer
